subject.title: fix(diagnostics): reclaim zombie embedded-run counters left idle by handle-mismatch clears

question: Should idle/no-queue sessions whose diagnostic activity still shows an active embedded run be eligible for active-abort recovery after stuckSessionAbortMs as a mitigation for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90240?
rationale: The patch is technically plausible, but it changes the recovery policy for idle session state and can force-clear embedded-run ownership; automation cannot choose that tradeoff for maintainers.

options.title: Refresh And Land Mitigation
options.body: Refresh on current main, preserve the progress-age invariant from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94701, rerun focused diagnostics validation, and land the bounded recovery path.

options.title: Wait For Prevention Fix
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers can prove and fix the stale active-run creation path instead of adding a recovery-only mitigation.

options.title: Fold Into Adjacent Recovery Work
options.body: Reconcile this with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94651 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98723 if maintainers want one combined session-state repair.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Land Mitigation
recommendation.body: Refresh on current main, preserve the progress-age invariant from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94701, rerun focused diagnostics validation, and land the bounded recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about diagnostic recovery policy, and history shows steipete as a central feature-history contributor for diagnostic thresholds and session-state extraction.
